description: Cross-cutting quality standards baked into every generated app. Enabled standards are threaded into architect/builder prompts and, where a deterministic check exists, enforced in the verify/security stages. Toggle individual standards off to reduce scope.

accessibility.label: Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
guidance: Semantic HTML, labelled form controls, alt text, keyboard navigation, visible focus states, sufficient colour contrast
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; ARIA only where semantics are insufficient

performance.label: Performance budgets (Core Web Vitals)
guidance: Code-split, lazy-load, cache; keep initial JS lean; server-render where possible
Target LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1, INP < 200ms

observability.label: Observability
guidance: Structured JSON logs with correlation ids; no secrets/PII in logs
/health (liveness) and /ready (readiness) endpoints
OpenTelemetry traces + basic metrics; error tracking hook (e.g. Sentry) behind env var

ux.label: UX polish
guidance: Responsive layout, dark mode, consistent design tokens/component library
Explicit empty, loading and error states; helpful onboarding and seed/demo data
Accessible, consistent forms with inline validation

i18n.label: Internationalization & SEO
guidance: Externalize user-facing strings for i18n; sensible default locale
SEO meta + Open Graph tags, sitemap.xml, robots.txt; PWA manifest where relevant

product.label: Product capabilities
guidance: Feature-flag mechanism (env or config driven)
Privacy-respecting analytics hook (disabled by default)
Transactional email/notification abstraction behind an interface

testing.label: Testing depth
guidance: Unit + integration tests with an ephemeral DB; contract alignment between frontend and backend
At least one end-to-end happy-path test (Playwright) and a smoke test
Coverage threshold configured (>= 60% lines) in the test runner

data.label: Data handling
guidance: Tag entity fields that are PII/PHI/PCI and handle them with encryption/field-level care
Database migrations (not auto-create) + seed script; documented backup/retention
